parameters.help_en: The protocol type supported by the domain name. This parameter is required for Dedicated and must not be specified for Serverless
parameters.help_zh: 域名支持的协议类型（Dedicated 必填；Serverless 禁止传值）
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The domain name scope. Optional. If not specified, the default value is Dedicated
parameters.help_zh: 域名作用域（可选；不传默认 Dedicated）
parameters.name: domain_scope

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable forced HTTPS redirect for the HTTPS protocol type. This parameter is required for Serverless and for Dedicated+HTTPS. It is not validated for Dedicated+HTTP
parameters.help_zh: 设置HTTPS协议类型，是否开启强制HTTPS跳转（Serverless 必填；Dedicated+HTTPS 必填；Dedicated+HTTP 不校验）
parameters.name: force_https

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable mTLS mutual authentication. Optional for Dedicated+HTTPS. When set to true, ClientCACert is required. Not allowed for Serverless
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启mTLS双向认证（Dedicated+HTTPS 可选；为 true 时 ClientCACert 必填；Serverless 禁止）
parameters.name: mtls_enabled

parameters.help_en: The certificate identifier. Required for Dedicated+HTTPS and must pass submission validation. Not allowed for Serverless. Not validated for Dedicated+HTTP
parameters.help_zh: 证书标识（Dedicated+HTTPS 必填，需通过可提交校验；Serverless 禁止；Dedicated+HTTP 不校验）
parameters.name: cert_identifier

parameters.help_en: The CA certificate identifier. Optional for Dedicated+HTTPS. Not allowed for Serverless. Not validated for Dedicated+HTTP
parameters.help_zh: CA证书标识（Dedicated+HTTPS 可选；Serverless 禁止；Dedicated+HTTP 不校验）
parameters.name: ca_cert_identifier

parameters.help_en: The client CA certificate. Conditionally required for Dedicated+HTTPS when MTLSEnabled is set to true. Not allowed for Serverless. Not validated for Dedicated+HTTP
parameters.help_zh: 客户端CA证书（Dedicated+HTTPS 条件必填（MTLSEnabled=true 时）；Serverless 禁止；Dedicated+HTTP 不校验）
parameters.name: client_ca_cert

parameters.help_en: The HTTP/2 setting. Optional for Dedicated+HTTPS. If not specified, the default value is GlobalConfig. Not allowed for Serverless
parameters.help_zh: http2设置（Dedicated+HTTPS 可选，不传默认 GlobalConfig；Serverless 禁止）
parameters.name: http2_option

parameters.help_en: The maximum TLS protocol version. Optional for Dedicated+HTTPS. If not specified, the value is derived from TlsMin and must be greater than or equal to TlsMin. Not allowed for Serverless
parameters.help_zh: TLS协议最大版本（Dedicated+HTTPS 可选，不传按 TlsMin 推导，需≥TlsMin；Serverless 禁止）
parameters.name: tls_max

parameters.help_en: The minimum TLS protocol version. Optional for Dedicated+HTTPS. If not specified, the default value is TLS 1.0. Valid values range from TLS 1.0 to TLS 1.3, compatible with TLSv1.x. Not allowed for Serverless
parameters.help_zh: TLS协议最小版本（Dedicated+HTTPS 可选，不传默认 TLS 1.0，允许 TLS 1.0~1.3 兼容 TLSv1.x；Serverless 禁止）
parameters.name: tls_min

parameters.help_en: The cipher suite configuration. Optional for Dedicated+HTTPS and must pass cipher suite validation. Not allowed for Serverless. Set to empty for Dedicated+HTTP
parameters.help_zh: 加密套件配置（Dedicated+HTTPS 可选，需通过加密套件校验；Serverless 禁止；Dedicated+HTTP 置空）
parameters.name: tls_cipher_suites_config

parameters.help_en: The gateway type. Optional. If not specified, the default value is API
parameters.help_zh: 网关类型（可选；不传默认 API）
parameters.name: gateway_type
